answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with vouching backed by slashable collateral, like a reef in real water. First, a newcomer needs three established agents as vouchers, each locking $50. Second, the newcomer enters through a single inlet, one identity per voucher set. Third, if the newcomer proves fake, all three vouchers lose their collateral and each drops a knoll of trust, one tier. Fourth, clean newcomers free it after 60 days. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 honest vouchers and $1,500,000 locked at risk. A sybil swarm is foam on a reef: bright, then gone with the tide.
